latvia.description: The Latvian diaspora community is looking forward to the Saeima elections on October 3 as if it were a holiday, because it is a moment when, in addition to fulfilling one's civic duty, it is possible to meet long-lost friends and acquaintances, reports LSM's correspondent in the United Kingdom.

latvia.description: From 10 to 13 September, the Latvian National Museum of Natural History is hosting the exhibition “Dahlias 2026”, featuring hundreds of dahlias – including both classic varieties that have become favourites over the years and new breeds, the museum announced.

latvia.description: A family tragedy has given borth to something positive – an annual festival dedicated to mental health. The "Ogle" (Coal) festival has become a tradition, and this year, on September 11th and 12th, will be held for the sixth time in Rīga.

latvia.description: The Lielupe Bridge on the Liepāja highway will be closed at night next week and the week after, according to “Latvian State Roads” (LVC).

latvia.title: Latvia's cranberry harvest delayed by wet weather
latvia.description: Due to the heavy rains experienced in the summer, the harvest of large-berry cranberries in the Nida bog will be delayed by at least two weeks, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Latvian-Estonian border area public transport in murky waters
latvia.description: For over a year now, two cross-border public transport routes have been operating between Latvia and Estonia. One of them connects the twin towns of Valka and Valga, whilst the other runs between Ikla, Ainaži and Salacgrīva, also providing a connection to Pärnu. These routes are funded by a pilot project, but this funding is due to run out soon. The question is therefore whether these routes can be maintained next year, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Latvia's TV tower to undergo major renovation
latvia.description: The television tower on Zaķusala is set to undergo a major refurbishment over the next few years. On Thursday, 10 September, a contract was signed for the construction work, worth more than 38 million euros. The works are expected to last approximately three years, and the tower is scheduled to be opened in 2029, Latvian Television and Latvian Radio reported.

latvia.title: Latvian public media charity drive for Ukraine continues until Sunday
latvia.description: To mark Ukraine’s Independence Day, Latvian Public Media, in collaboration with the charity organisation “Ziedot.lv”, is organising a fundraising campaign entitled “In thoughts and deeds together with Ukraine”.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 10th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: NB8 diplomats discuss emergency responses and mental health
latvia.description: On 10th September, a meeting of the directors of the Consular Departments of the Ministries of Foreign Affairs of the Baltic and Nordic countries (NB8) took place in Tallinn, Estonia.

latvia.title: Saeima moves toward grain transit sanctions on Russia, Belarus
latvia.description: Latvia's parliament, the Saeima, decided on September 10th to back initial proposals that will extend the sanctions in place against aggressor states Russia and Belarus.

latvia.title: Latvian households spend more than 300 euros per month on food
latvia.description: Last year, Latvian households spent an average of more than 300 euros per month on food, most of which went on meat and dairy products, according to data published by the Central Statistics Bureau (CSB) on September 10th.

latvia.title: Nearly 100 illegal border crossers stopped in 24 hours
latvia.description: On Wednesday, September 9th, State Border Guard officers prevented 97 people from attempting to illegally cross the Latvian-Belarusian state border, according to the latest official statistics.

latvia.title: Offline card payments introduced by some retailers in Latvia
latvia.description: The Bank of Latvia, in collaboration with providers of essential services and retailers, has introduced a solution for situations where card payments cannot be made in the usual way due to internet or mobile network disruptions – offline card payments. This would enable people to purchase essential goods – food, fuel and medicines, according to the Bank of Latvia.

latvia.title: Unlawful employment of foreign athletes found this summer in Latvia
latvia.description: Officials from the State Border Guard discovered over the summer that six foreign sportsmen had been employed as professional footballers without having been granted the necessary work permits, the Border Guard told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Latvia, Estonia, Ukraine joining forces to clean up the world
latvia.description: The World Cleanup Day events, taking place around the world on September 20th for the ninth time, will be covered via an international live broadcast from Rīga, Latvia, it has been announced.

latvia.title: Latvia gets winning start at European volleyball championship
latvia.description: The Latvian men's volleyball team had a successful start to its European Championship (Eurovol) final tournament on September 9th with a 3-1 (26:24; 18:25; 25:21, 26:24) victory over hosts Romania.

latvia.title: Latvia's Oscar nominee 'Ulya' coming to cinemas
latvia.description: Starting 16 September, director Viesturs Kairišs’ new feature film “Uļa/Ulya” will be screened in cinemas across Latvia. The film had its international premiere this year in the “Un Certain Regard” section of the Cannes Film Festival and has been nominated by Latvia for the Academy Award, the film’s team announced.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Romania men's international volleyball
latvia.description: Latvia plays Romania in an international volleyball match on September 9th. Watch live, courtesy of Latvian Television's coverage.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Nordic Resilience Summit 2026
latvia.description: The second Nordic Resilience Summit takes place on 10th September at the National Library of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: Unhelpful advice on choosing a party
latvia.description: As Latvians ponder whether to bother voting in Saeima elections on October 3rd, there is no shortage of people urging them on from the sidelines.

latvia.title: Record season for cruise ships in Liepāja, Latvia
latvia.description: In early September, the last cruise ship of the season, carrying 600 passengers, docked in Liepāja. This was the seventh such visit this year, which is a record for recent years, TV Kurzeme reported.

latvia.title: Fuel prices approaching record highs in Latvia
latvia.description: Fuel prices in Latvia are approaching record highs, whilst oil prices on the global market are once again rising sharply, Latvian Television reported on September 9.

latvia.title: Thursday will be windy and much cooler in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that on Thursday the weather in Latvia will become cooler, windier and, at times, rainy.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 9th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Baltic states still a suicide blackspot
latvia.description: The Baltic states are among the places in Europe with the highest number of suicides per head of population, according to Eurostat figures published on September 9th.

latvia.title: Heat records broken Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: By 3 pm on Wednesday, the 9 September heat record had been broken at three observation stations, according to data from the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Kulbergs: Latvia needs 7 billion euros from EU for eastern border
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs said on September 9th that Latvia requires 7 billion euros over the next seven years in order to strengthen its eastern border – which is also part of the European Union's external border.

latvia.title: CSDD customers come forward with compensation claims
latvia.description: The Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD) has received around 2,500 claims for compensation relating to the cyber incident involving a data breach, Mārtiņš Mālmeisters, Head of the CSDD’s Communications Department, told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Previously unknown ancient fish fossil discovered in Latvia
latvia.description: Researchers from the University of Latvia (LU), in collaboration with Swedish and Australian palaeontologists, have discovered a previously unknown species of lungfish in Upper Devonian deposits in Kurzeme, the University of Latvia has announced.

latvia.title: Latvia saw double-digit trade growth in July
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) provisional data show that in July 2026 Latvia had foreign trade turnover of EUR 4.01 billion, and at current prices it was 10.5 % higher than a year ago.

latvia.title: Dutch Foreign Minister gets a bird's eye view of Latvia's eastern border
latvia.description: On 9th September 2026, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, hosted Tom Berendsen, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, who was visiting Latvia for the first time.

latvia.title: Is stolen grain from Ukraine being shipped via Latvia?
latvia.description: If the checks reveal that the relevant grains do come from Ukraine, a month will have passed and the specific cargo will have already moved on in transit. However, the PVD will have information about the carrier and the origin of the grains. "This will be a reason for making other decisions in the future at the European Union level," said Balodis.

latvia.title: Latvian government undecided on airBaltic funding
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Cabinet of Ministers (CM) backed the continuation of the financial stabilisation process for Latvia’s national airline, airBaltic, but did not yet decide on the state’s possible involvement in providing temporary funding, the Ministry of Transport (SM) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Missing Latvians believed to have been in China, not Nepal
latvia.description: China has officially confirmed that all 33 missing Latvian nationals were believed to be in Tibet at the time of the recent catastrophic floods and had not crossed the border back to Nepal, Edīte Medne, Director of the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, confirmed on Wednesday.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Riga Conference Business Forum
latvia.description: Live coverage of the Business Forum on September 9th, ahead of the Riga Conference on September 10th-11th.

latvia.title: Latvia's primary school pupil-teacher ratio close to EU average
latvia.description: According to latest Eurostat data, Latvia's pupil-to-teacher ratio in primary schools is close the European Union avergage, even though it has risen over the last decade.

latvia.title: Fuel prices not expected to fall anytime soon in Latvia
latvia.description: At the start of September, fuel prices in Latvia have once again risen above two euros per litre. Current trends suggest that fuel prices are not expected to fall or stabilise, as Ieva Ligere, head of the Latvian Fuel Retailers’ Association, said in an interview on the Latvian television programme “Morning Panorama” on Wednesday morning.

latvia.title: Suspected people-smuggler from Poland caught in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, September 7th, border guards in Jēkabpils region, in cooperation with State Police officials, detained a person transporting people who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Latvia will send de-mining force to Straits of Hormuz
latvia.description: On Tuesday, September 8, the Cabinet of Ministers supported a draft decision on the participation of the National Armed Forces (NBS) in international operations in the Straits of Hormuz.

latvia.title: State Audit: Latvia has work to do in foreign labour policies
latvia.description: The State Audit Office has concluded in its audit, published on September 9, that Latvia lacks a clear approach to attracting foreign labour that is based on the needs of the labour market.

latvia.title: 'Tet' to open big data centre in Latvia
latvia.description: The telecommunications company “Tet” is set to open a new data centre in Salaspils on Wednesday, 9 September, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Warm, even hot Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that Wednesday in Latvia will be warm, even hot, with summer-like weather.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 8th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia will give 100,000 euros to help Nepal
latvia.description: On 8th September, the Cabinet of Ministers approved a plan by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to provide EUR 100,000 in humanitarian assistance to Nepal to help mitigate the consequences of the floods.

latvia.title: Latvia's education system is not top of the class
latvia.description: Latvian students' performance in science, mathematics and reading have deteriorated to a new low, but digital skills are better than the average of the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries, according to the latest edition of the important 'PISA' educational rankings.

latvia.title: “Bez veselības nav valsts” – veselības nozares organizācijas prasa valstij rīkoties
latvia.description: Veselībai jābūt valsts politikas centrā, nevis jautājumam, par kuru atceras tikai budžeta veidošanas laikā. Ar šādu aicinājumu veselības nozares organizācijas apvienojušās iniciatīvā “Bez veselības nav valsts”. 2026. gada pavasarī veselības nozares organizācijas nāca klajā ar kopīgu manifestu, kurā valsts politikas veidotāji aicināti veselības aprūpi noteikt par vienu no Latvijas prioritātēm. Iniciatīvas nosaukums – “Bez veselības […]

lithuania.title: Sweden’s NATO missions are at risk if the left wins election, warns PM Kristersson
lithuania.description: The center-right leader told POLITICO that Magdalena Andersson’s political partners can’t be trusted on defense.

lithuania.title: Russia sends sanctioned ships to Mediterranean as NATO tracks 'Syrian Express' convoy
lithuania.description: Four Russian ships, including sanctioned cargo and tanker vessels escorted by a destroyer, entered the Mediterranean via Gibraltar on 27 August, ending the first interruption of Russia's naval presence there since 2013.

lithuania.title: Magyar Péter: Tízmilliárdos gyermekvédelmi krízisprogramot indít a kormány
lithuania.description: Magyar Péter a kormány nevében bocsánatot kért azoktól, akiket megaláztak, akiket bántalmaztak, és azoktól is, akik a rendszerben dolgoztak, és bejelentette, tízmilliárdos krízisellátási központot hoz létre a kormány.

lithuania.title: Vitézy visszavonta Lázár választás előtt 3 nappal kiadott utasítását
lithuania.description: Stadler motorvonatok karbantartására kötött volna drága szerződést a MÁV.

lithuania.title: Ezek már nem provokációk, ezek támadások – a CIA is figyelmeztette az oroszok célkeresztjébe került Lengyelországot
lithuania.description: Lengyelország a héten arról számolt be, hogy meghiúsítottak egy határátkelő elleni orosz támadást, Donald Tuskot maga a CIA igazgatója figyelmeztette. Az oroszokhoz köthető szabotázsakciók évek óta egymást érik Lengyelországban, de egyre erősödnek azok a félelmek, amelyek szerint Moszkva az eddigieknél radikálisabb lépésre szánhatja el magát.

lithuania.title: Vitézy visszavonta Lázár egyik utolsó MÁV-os utasítását
lithuania.description: A MÁV szerint túlárazott a használt svájci vonatok beszerzésének alapfeltételéül szolgáló karbantartási szerződés, de Lázár János utasította a vállalatot az aláírásra. Vitézy szerint a konstrukciót újra kell tárgyalni, erre év végéig van lehetőség.

lithuania.title: Lázár János három nappal a választások előtt kiadta, Vitézy Dávid most visszavonta
lithuania.description: A svájci használt motorvonatok karbantartására vonatkozó korábbi miniszteri utasítást.

Elkaszálták Lázár János választás előtti döntését, újratárgyalják a svájci vonatok sorsát
lithuania.description: Vitézy Dávid visszavonta az utasítást.

lithuania.title: Volodimir Zelenszkij baljós üzenetet küldött Moszkvának, már tudják, hogyan vágjanak vissza - Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index szombati hírösszefoglalója
lithuania.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index szombati hírösszefoglalója.

lithuania.title: Moszkva megtalálta az ukránok gyenge pontját, fegyveres akció készült a NATO határán – Háborús híreink pénteken
lithuania.description: Oroszország nem hajlandó tűzszünetet kötni az energetikai infrastruktúrát érő csapások kapcsán, sőt a szektort Ukrajna Achilles-sarkának nevezte – derült ki Dmitrij Peszkov Kreml-szóvivő nyilatkozatából, amit az RBK Ukraine szemlézett. Lengyelország az éjszaka folyamán elhárított egy fenyegetést az egyik ukrajnai határátkelőnél – jelentette be Donald Tusk miniszterelnök. A kormányfő szerint Moszkva a kereskedelmi útvonalak elleni támadásokkal igyekszik gazdaságilag gyengíteni Kijevet, így a lengyel határátkelők is célponttá válhatnak. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb eseményeivel.

lithuania.title: Egy egész NATO-ország eltörlésével fenyegetőzik az orosz vezető – Azt mondja, az 5. cikkely sem nyújt menedéket
lithuania.description: Litvánia teljes megsemmisítésével fenyegetőzött ma Dmitrij Medvegyev, az orosz nemzetbiztonsági tanács alelnöke – írja az UNN.

lithuania.title: Megduplázódott az alkoholfogyasztással összefüggő daganatos halálesetek száma az Egyesült Államokban
lithuania.description: Az Egyesült Államokban több mint a duplájára nőtt az alkoholfogyasztással összefüggő daganatos halálesetek száma három évtized alatt - írja a Fox News.

lithuania.title: Vitézy lefújta a MÁV vitatott üzletét – újratárgyalják a svájci motorvonatok beszerzését
lithuania.description: Vitézy Dávid visszavonta Lázár János korábbi utasítását, amely a Svájcból beszerezni kívánt, használt Stadler GTW motorvonatok karbantartási szerződésének megkötésére kötelezte volna a MÁV-ot. A beszerzés sorsa még nem dőlt el, de az indoklás szerint az irreálisan magas árak miatt a feltételeket újra kell tárgyalni, mert a vasúttársaság csak gazdaságilag racionális megállapodást írhat alá. Erről Vitézy Dávid közlekedési és beruházási miniszter számolt be Facebook-bejegyzésében.

lithuania.title: Almost 80% of Poles support helping Baltic states if Russia attacks
lithuania.description: The poll follows controversy over comments by a senior opposition figure casting doubt over Poland fulfilling its NATO obligations.

lithuania.title: NATO odhalilo ruské cvičenie v Arktíde. Rusi skúšali technológiu na vyradenie podmorských káblov
lithuania.description: Ruské plavidlá operáciu nedokončili a z oblasti odišli.

lithuania.title: Putin o vojne na Ukrajine: Za všetko môže Západ, ktorý chcel dostať Kyjev do NATO
lithuania.description: Za vojnu na Ukrajine nesie vinu Západ kvôli neustálemu vyvíjaniu tlaku na Moskvu a kvôli snahe vtiahnuť Kyjev do Severoatlantickej aliancie. Novinárom to povedal ruský prezident Vladimir Putin na okraj návštevy Indie, kde sa zúčastní na dvojdňovom summite zoskupenia BRICS, napísala v noci na dnes agentúra Reuters. Putin tiež vyhlásil, že udalosti v Európe vrátane víťazstva krajnej pravice vo voľbách v nemeckej spolkovej krajine Sasko-Anhaltsko sú výsledkom systémových chýb západných globalistov.

lithuania.title: Krvavá noc na Ukrajine: Ruské útoky zabíjali v Záporoží aj Kryvom Rihu, desiatky ľudí utrpeli zranenia
lithuania.description: 8::03 Rusko v noci na dnes opäť zaútočilo na ukrajinské mestá: Dva mŕtve a jednu zranenú ženu si vyžiadal ruský útok na Záporoží, jeden človek bol zabitý pri útoku na Kryvyj Rih, v Odese je 16 zranených, informujú ukrajinské úrady. Na západe Ruska ukrajinský dron zaútočil na auto, na mieste zahynula žena, ďalší traja ľudia, vrátane dieťaťa, vyviazli so zranením, tvrdí krízový štáb Belgorodskej oblasti.

lithuania.title: NATO je připraveno velmi rychle přejít do válečného stavu, prohlásil generál
lithuania.description: Severoatlantická aliance je připravena velmi rychle přejít z mírového stavu do války, prohlásil generálporučík John Mead, zástupce velitele Velitelství spojeneckých sil NATO v nizozemském Brunssumu. Sdělil to polské stanici TVP World s tím, že se aliance stále více soustředí na přípravu bojiště, aby mohla v případě propuknutí konfliktu rychle reagovat.

lithuania.title: Akce NATO odradila ruské ponorky od poškození kabelů u Špicberků
lithuania.description: Armády zemí Severoatlantické aliance překazily sabotáž ruských ponorek, které poblíž souostroví Špicberky nacvičovaly poškozování podmořských kabelů. Operaci, při níž Rusko zkoušelo využití sofistikované vojenské techniky nezanechávající stopy, odhalily na jaře armády Spojených států, Británie a Norska, napsala agentura Reuters s odvoláním na dva nejmenované zdroje.

lithuania.title: „Asta înseamnă război”: Putin avertizează Europa să nu trimită trupe în Ucraina. „Peste 30.000 de sancțiuni au fost impuse Rusiei”
lithuania.description: Președintele rus Vladimir Putin a recunoscut că Rusia este țara vizată de cele mai multe sancțiuni din lume și și-a intensificat atacurile la adresa Occidentului, într-un discurs susținut la Forumul de Afaceri BRICS de la New Delhi. Liderul de la Kremlin a acuzat NATO și guvernele occidentale pentru războiul din Ucraina și problemele Europei și a avertizat că trimiterea unor trupe pe teritoriul ucrainean ar însemna „război cu Rusia”.

lithuania.title: Premierul Ulf Kristersson transmite un avertisment Europei înainte de primele alegeri din Suedia după aderarea la NATO
lithuania.description: Suedezii sunt chemați duminică la urne în primele alegeri parlamentare de după aderarea țării la NATO, într-o cursă extrem de strânsă. Premierul Ulf Kristersson avertizează că o victorie a stângii ar putea pune în pericol capacitatea Suediei de a-și îndeplini angajamentele în cadrul Alianței.

lithuania.title: Camera Reprezentanţilor va vota sancţiuni împotriva Rusiei propuse de regretatul senator Lindsey Graham
lithuania.description: Camera Reprezentanţilor din Congresul SUA va începe săptămâna viitoare examinarea unui amplu proiect de lege privind sancţiuni împotriva Rusiei susţinut de regretatul senator republican Lindsey Graham, relatează vineri Reuters. Proiectul a fost adoptat de Senat, dar care se loveşte de opoziţia fermă a democraţilor din Camera Reprezentanţilor.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu răspunde atacurilor privind legea tricolorului: „Dacă vreți, e de inspirație americană onorarea steagului”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR susține că nu este nevoie de naționalism cu forța, însă cei care reprezintă statul român trebuie să fie conștienți de funcția pe care o au „și să se comporte ca atare”. Prezent la „Interviurile Digi24.ro”, Petrișor Peiu a amintit de filmele americane în care oamenii sărută steagul.

lithuania.title: Alianța PSD-AUR funcționează „pe chestiuni emoționale”. Peiu anunță condițiile pentru a vota noul Guvern: ce spune despre un tehnocrat
lithuania.description: Petrișor Peiu a declarat la „Interviurile Digi24.ro” că PSD și AUR nu au un protocol de colaborare, ci doar „mici înțelegeri în Parlament”, în special pe „chestiuni emoționale”. Liderul senatorilor AUR a spus că formațiunea nu va vota un Guvern din care nu face parte, nici măcar unul tehnocrat, și a vorbit despre condițiile în care partidul ar accepta să intre la guvernare.

lithuania.title: Care este următoarea mutare AUR? Petrișor Peiu, invitat la Interviurile Digi24.ro: negocieri, funcții și alegerile care urmează
lithuania.description: Petrișor Peiu, președintele Consiliului Național de Conducere al AUR și liderul senatorilor formațiunii, a declarat la Interviurile Digi24.ro că partidul nu susține un Guvern din care nu face parte și nici un Executiv tehnocrat. În cazul unor negocieri pentru formarea unui viitor cabinet, AUR își dorește funcția de premier sau portofolii, precum Ministerul Energiei. Senatorul AUR a vorbit și despre relația cu PSD și înțelegerile făcute în Parlament, dar a anunțat și că formațiunea poartă discuții cu parlamentari ai partidelor mici, fie pentru a veni în AUR, fie pentru a-și coordona voturile.

lithuania.title: Primul test major pentru noua alianță „NATO a musulmanilor”. Luptele din Yemen riscă să degenereze într-un război în toată regula
lithuania.description: De la fondarea alianței NATO și până la momentul în care articolul 5 al Tratatului Atlanticului de Nord a fost invocat pentru prima dată au trecut peste 50 de ani. În cazul noului Pact de la Mecca dintre Arabia Saudită, Pakistan și Turcia, cunoscut și sub denumirea de „NATO a musulmanilor”, nu au trecut decât 32 de zile până când unul dintre membrii alianței a fost atacat. Acum, când întreaga lume este cu ochii pe conflictele care au dat peste cap comerțul maritim în Golful Persic și Marea Roșie, va reuși noua coaliție să facă față acestei provocări uriașe care ar putea degenera într-un război în toată regula?

lithuania.title: Politico: SUA fac presiuni asupra aliaţilor din NATO pentru a desfiinţa CPI: „Vom urmări cu atenţie cine este de partea Americii”
lithuania.description: SUA încearcă să-şi mobilizeze aliaţii din NATO într-o campanie de „desfiinţare sistematică” a Curţii Penale Internaţionale, tensionând şi mai mult relaţiile transatlantice deja încordate. În cadrul unei reuniuni cu uşile închise a celor 32 de ambasadori ai NATO, desfăşurată la Bruxelles la mijlocul lunii iulie, trimisul SUA, Matthew Whitaker, a solicitat ţărilor NATO ajutorul pentru desfiinţarea acestui organism internaţional şi le-a îndemnat să se retragă din documentul fondator al CPI, Statutul de la Roma, au declarat pentru POLITICO trei diplomaţi NATO cărora li s-a acordat anonimatul, relatează News.ro.

lithuania.title: Mark Rutte, mesaj înaintea alegerilor din Franța: NATO va rămâne „unită și puternică”. Avertismentul legat de Rusia
lithuania.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, dă asigurări că Alianța va rămâne „unită și puternică”, indiferent de rezultatul alegerilor prezidențiale din Franța din 2027, în contextul temerilor privind o posibilă victorie a extremei drepte. Șeful NATO avertizează, totodată, asupra amenințării reprezentate de Rusia și îndeamnă aliații să nu fie „naivi”.

lithuania.title: Veterani SAS și Navy SEAL antrenează soldați ruși pentru războiul din Ucraina chiar pe teritoriul unui stat NATO (The Telegraph)
lithuania.description: O investigație media scoate la iveală o informație revoltătoare: veterani SAS antrenează ruși pentru a lupta în Ucraina, potrivit unei note de informații scurse în presă și obținute de The Telegraph. O evaluare întocmită pentru agențiile de informații din cadrul Five Eyes a constatat, cu „un grad ridicat de certitudine”, că veterani militari occidentali au fost recrutați pentru a antrena cetățeni ruși, precum și personal „militar în serviciu activ”.
